item.title: Apple Store Walk‑In Limits for iPhone Duo Launch
item.description: Apple will stock limited iPhone Duo units for walk‑in shoppers in 16 markets on Oct 23, using reservations elsewhere to curb crowds and scalpers.

item.title: Where Apple’s iPhone Duo Will and Won’t Accept Walk‑Ins
item.description: An look at Apple’s iPhone Duo walk‑in policy, why store availability matters, technical logistics, and what it signals for the mobile global market.

item.title: Apple Readies iPhone 18 Pro Launch at Fifth Avenue
item.description: Apple CEO John Ternus teases the iPhone 18 Pro launch tomorrow, unveiling Burgundy and Glacier colors as the Fifth Avenue glass cube gets a look.

item.title: Apple Store Outage Pre‑iPhone 18 Pro & Duo Fold
item.description: Apple’s online store went offline just before the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo foldable launch, raising questions about infrastructure readiness and event‑day reliability for millions of customers worldwide.
